newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO SAYS MONSANTO PLAN UNCLEAR.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO SAYS MONSANTO PLAN UNCLEAR.

text.p: Finnish food group Raisio said on Thursday it did not know enough about a cholesterol-cutting oil to be developed by U.S. Monsanto Co to say if the product could become a rival to its Benecol agent.
"We don't know enough about it yet," Raisio Yhtyma Oy spokesman Sten von Hellens told Reuters by telephone. "If it is a vegetable oil ... then it may not be a direct competitor."
The Monsanto product might not amount to "anything particular" from Raisio's point of view, von Hellens said.
"It is one more vegetable oil. It is well known that the use of vegetable oils has a favourable effect on cholesterol levels," he said.
"They don't say, for example, by how much their product could lower cholesterol levels among users," von Hellens said.

He pointed to medical research showing Raisio's Benecol had cut cholesterol levels by 10 percent when used regularly. The cholesterol reducing effect was starting to set in after two to three weeks of use, he said, referring to the research.
Asked about the sharp fall in Raisio's share in early trade on Thursday, on the news Monsanto was developing the oil, von Hellens said Raisio's stock had ben "very volatile" recently.
"There have been a number of rumours in the market and every time something happens with the share," he said.
